pois.name: Waikiki Beach & Coastal Promenade
pois.description: Relax on Hawaii's world-famous golden sand beach featuring calm turquoise Pacific waters, palm-fringed promenades, and stunning views of Diamond Head crater.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Iconic Hawaiian coastal destination
✓ Free entry
✓ Perfect morning sea breeze
✓ 4.8★ reviews
pois.tip: Visit early in the morning for calm water and quiet beach walks before surfing crowds arrive.

pois.name: Diamond Head State Monument
pois.description: Hike up the volcanic crater summit trail leading to 360-degree panoramic ocean views over Honolulu, Waikiki, and the Pacific coastline.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Premier hiking & volcanic crater viewpoint
✓ Fits $5 entrance budget
✓ 4.7★ reviews
✓ Unmatched panoramic ocean vistas
pois.tip: Pre-book trail entrance reservations online and bring plenty of water for the sunny stair climb.

pois.name: Duke's Waikiki
pois.description: Enjoy legendary beachfront dining right on the sand, famous for fresh island mahi-mahi, tropical cocktails, and original Kimo's Hula Pie.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Beachfront dining on Waikiki sand
✓ 300m walk from beach promenade
✓ Highly rated for fresh seafood & Hula Pie
✓ Ocean view lunch
pois.tip: Ask for an outdoor ocean-front table and make sure to save room for the famous Hula Pie dessert.
pois.signature_dish: Fresh Macadamia Nut Crust Mahi-Mahi & Original Hula Pie

pois.name: Pearl Harbor National Memorial
pois.description: Honor historic WWII events at the Pearl Harbor Visitor Center, featuring museum galleries, historic film screenings, and boat tours to the USS Arizona Memorial.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Historic national WWII monument
✓ Free general admission
✓ Essential cultural & historical destination
✓ 4.8★ reviews
pois.tip: Reserve boat tickets to the USS Arizona Memorial online in advance as daily slots fill early.
